description: Retain a closed uniform Catmull-Rom spline from explicit planar controls with direct parameter and approximate distance queries.

provenance.relationship: Motivating retained closed spline; control generation, center, fan drawing and marks remain composition.
Independent motivating closed spline and distance lookup; randomized controls and spline tile drawing remain composition.

output_invariants: Controls remain in supplied order and are detached; the curve is cyclic uniform Catmull-Rom. length is the final retained cumulative chord total; zero chords and rounded plateaus remain represented. Queries are periodic; tangent is the raw analytic derivative with respect to local uniform span parameter, not a unit or distance derivative. No simple-polygon, convexity, equidistant-spacing or closure drawing guarantee.

behavior.creation: Create from exactly {controls,subdivisions}. Controls is an ordered list of N exact [x,y] pairs, N>=3, finite binary64 coordinates in caller drawing units. R is an integer>=1, the number of equal-parameter chords in each control-to-control span. Both are required; no defaults or encouraged artistic ranges. Validate top-level keys, control count, R and product bounds before coordinates in row order, x then y. N<=268435455 permits packed8N coefficient storage; N*R<=2147483646 permits a signed32 indexed cumulative table of N*R+1 entries. These are representation bounds, not allocation promises. A nonfinite computed intermediate raises NUMERIC_OVERFLOW without exposing a curve. Duplicate and all-coincident controls are allowed; no sorting, removal or zero-chord pruning.
behavior.arithmetic: All primitives separately round IEEE754 binary64 nearest ties-to-even; no FMA, reassociation or extended intermediates. For span i, p0=control[(i-1+N)%N], p1=control[i], p2=control[(i+1)%N], p3=control[(i+2)%N], independently for x and y: a=0.5*(((-p0+3*p1)-3*p2)+p3); b=0.5*(((2*p0-5*p1)+4*p2)-p3); c=0.5*(-p0+p2); d=p1; position(t)=((a*t+b)*t+c)*t+d; tangent(t)=(3*a*t+2*b)*t+c. Check every primitive result for finiteness. At t=0 return p1 exactly and tangent c; at t=1 advance to the next span and use its t=0 rule. Canonicalize exposed zeros to +0.
behavior.table: Use fdlibm5.3 StrictMath.hypot. Build cumulative[0]=0; for each span i, start at control[i], evaluate j=1..R at binary64 j/R (j=R uses the exact endpoint rule), measure each chord from the preceding sample, and add its length to the running total. Retain every running total in span/subdivision order, including zero chords and rounded plateaus. Final total is approximate arc length, not analytically integrated perimeter.
behavior.queries: Validate query shape, mode, value and target before constant-curve shortcuts. Query mode is parameter or distance. Wrap finite v to period P using binary64 remainder truncated toward zero; if w<0 add P; if w==P or w==0 canonicalize +0. Parameter uses P=N, i=floor(w), t=w-i. Distance with length0 returns control0 and span0 tangent after validation. Otherwise wrap by P=length; w==0 uses span0,t=0 before any search. For w>0 use upper-bound search for largest cumulative[k]<=w, skipping equal plateaus; u=(w-cumulative[k])/(cumulative[k+1]-cumulative[k]); span=floor(k/R), local=(k%R+u)/R, then evaluate the cubic, using the endpoint rule when local==1. Nonfinite query intermediates raise NUMERIC_OVERFLOW; no partial output.
behavior.native_surface: Java org.procedurals.paths.ClosedSpline2D.create(Object) and create(double[][] controls,int subdivisions) share validation and one kernel. serialize() returns detached {controls,subdivisions}. sampleParameter(double) and sampleDistance(double) return immutable Sample with x(),y(),tangentX(),tangentY(); target-array overloads write exactly four entries [x,y,tangentX,tangentY] without allocation. sample(Object) accepts exactly {mode,value} and returns {point:[x,y],tangent:[dx,dy]}. length(), controlCount() and subdivisions() expose metadata. No generic callbacks or mutable buffers.
behavior.ownership: Copy all inputs; no aliases are retained. Exports and Sample results are detached. Failed creation or query exposes no partial result. Work is O(N*R), retained storage O(N*R+N), parameter query O(1), distance query O(log(N*R)). No renderer, RNG, time or assets.
behavior.carriers: Object records use exact passive Map/List containers. Java numeric carriers are Byte, Short, Integer, Long, Float and Double; reject null, boolean, strings, arrays in object route, arbitrary Number subclasses, BigInteger and BigDecimal. Typed arrays are copied. Validate target-array scalar then target and calculate into locals; errors never partially modify target.
behavior.normative_contract: design/operations/closed-spline-contract.md is normative for precise validation order, arithmetic, endpoint/plateau decisions and atomic target writes.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Malformed static carrier/key/value, fewer than three controls, invalid subdivision or representation bound.
errors.INVALID_QUERY: Malformed query, mode/value, nonfinite scalar or invalid target.
errors.NUMERIC_OVERFLOW: Nonfinite computed creation or query intermediate; no partial result.

controls.evidence: blobs#0 and databol#0 report large changes from control-count edits; no public control-count recommendation.

subdivisions.evidence: CP16 probe compares 10,32,128,1024 chords; resolution is a numerical accuracy/work choice, not a justified default or range.

query.unit: parameter: control-span units with period N; distance: drawing units with period approximate length; returned tangent: drawing units per local span parameter
query.evidence: The two source Spline implementations expose parameter/distance lookup; periodic wrapping and per-chord inversion are explicit portable design.

processing-java.delivery_scope: Java first; implementation and native review pending.

reproduction.acceptance: LoopMarks must show a control edit, independent recoloring and a changed mark using retained curves; no source recreation credit or native support follows from this catalog entry.

review.status: Root approved for Java implementation against normative semantics and analytical fixtures; no implementation, native or distribution acceptance.
